$comment: Policy FLOOR for gated workflow runs (StartWorkflowRun/CompleteRunStep/SubmitGateDecision on the propel-sdlc MCP server). Read client-side and passed as the gatePolicyJson argument -- the server has no repo access and never reads this file itself. Mandates here cannot be lowered by --approve= at invocation time. `default` is a starting value and IS overridable. Match granularity: `workflow` (whole workflow), `workflow`+`step` (a specific step id, e.g. "S1" -- opaque/positional, breaks silently if step ids get reshuffled across a manifest version bump), `workflow`+`prompt` (a specific prompt by its stable name, e.g. "create-spec" -- PREFERRED over `step` for exactly this reason), `artifact_key` (real project-config.json keys), or `ai_signal`. Fields combine with AND within one mandate; add separate mandate entries for OR. Omitting `workflow` on a `prompt` match makes it global -- every workflow that runs that prompt inherits the mandate, not just one.

mandatory.reason: Prototype output touches real code paths and must be reviewed before any merge, regardless of caller request
Architecture decisions require human review before downstream steps (modeling, UI spec) build on them
